final: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_ratio FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_of_averages FROM media_averages) SELECT media_type_name, average_ratio, average_ratio / NULLIF(average_of_averages, 0) FROM media_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_of_averages IS NOT NULL
